description: Compare 2 to 4 products side by side, as the store's compare page does: each product's card, then the spec rows by group with one value per product in the order given, whether each row differs and which value is better where a spec can be ranked. differences says whether any row differs. A product that cannot be compared (another category, past the limit, not found) is listed under rejected with the reason. url opens the same comparison on the store's website when it has a compare page.

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

products.description: 2 to 4 products of one category: public_id, page URL or model number.

items.description: The product: its public_id from an earlier answer, its page URL or slug on the store's website, or the manufacturer model number.

name: compare_products

answer_type.description: What this answer is, for rendering.

category.description: The category the comparison is in.

comparison.description: Null with fewer than two comparable products.

best.description: Per product: true where that value is the better one.

values.description: One value per product, null where it has none; true/false for yes/no specs.

products.description: The compared products, in the order given.

branches.description: The stores or warehouses holding it, each with its state. Empty when the store does not say.

label.description: The stock line the store's website shows, in the answer language.

badges.description: For example new, sale or featured.

amount.description: The price a visitor pays, in the card's currency; null when on request or not on sale.

compare_at.description: The higher crossed-out price of a sale.

on_request.description: True: the price is given on request (call or message the store).

public_id.description: Pass it to get_product or compare_products.

url.description: The product page on the store's website, in the answer language; cite it.

product.description: The product as given or its public_id.

truncated.description: Present and true only when the answer outgrew the size budget and its last list items were left out; ask narrower to see them.

url.description: This comparison on the store's website; null when it has no compare page.

title: Compare products
